decision: Owner decision, Michael, 2026-11-22 (chat 06:48Z; Sector_Ops #51 comment 7075545102): the Great Lakes Low Water Datum (IGLD 1985) is an allowed Depth reference.
note: Low Water Datum (chart datum) per lake, IGLD 1985. Feet are NOAA's published values; metres agree with CHS. NOAA notes IGLD 1985 is being replaced by IGLD 2020: when the level series moves to IGLD 2020 these values no longer apply and the lakes must be refused until this table is updated.

evidence.quote: LWD: Superior 183.2 m / 601.1 ft; Michigan and Huron 176.0 m / 577.5 ft; St. Clair 174.4 m / 572.3 ft; Erie 173.5 m / 569.2 ft; Ontario 74.2 m / 243.3 ft
evidence.note: paraphrased from the page's table (it lists the Ontario stations under their own names), not a verbatim quote

evidence.quote: Lake Superior chart datum 183.2 m; Michigan and Huron 176.0 m; St. Clair 174.4 m; Erie 173.5 m; Ontario 74.2 m
evidence.note: paraphrased per lake; the page states that Great Lakes water level elevations are given in IGLD 1985 but does not repeat it next to each chart datum

levelSide: NOAA CO-OPS Great Lakes water levels requested with datum IGLD are IGLD 1985 (series name water_level_IGLD85 in the research bindings); Depth reads that series name as the level datum, like a USGS parameter code.
